sample_unit: patients with lung cancer visible on neck CT

links.outcome: Proportion of visible incidental lung cancers on neck CT not described in original reports
links.effect: 80 of 123 (65.0%) lung cancers visible on neck CT were not described in the original reports; missed cases had longer diagnostic interval (27.5 vs 0 months) and more stage shift (47.5% vs 11.6%).
links.quote: Of 81,794 patients screened, 123 with lung cancer visible on neck CT were identified (mean age, 65.1 ± 10.5 years; 63 male), of whom 80 (65.0%) were not described in the original reports.

links.outcome: AI-CAD detection of lung lesions missed by radiologists on neck CT
links.effect: AI-CAD detected 41 of 80 missed lesions (51.3%), without significant variations across imaging or lesion characteristics; standalone retrospective application, not with users.
links.quote: AI-CAD detected 41 of 80 missed lesions (51.3%), without significant variations across imaging or lesion characteristics.

unlisted_practices: Double reading of neck CT by radiologists associated with fewer missed incidental lung cancers (OR 0.16)

screen.reason: Evaluates the retrospective detection performance of an AI-CAD tool on missed incidental lung cancers on neck CT scans.
